observations: Photo 0 shows the rear of a black thermal printer with a manufacturer label.

No POS terminal, monitor, or computer unit is visible in any of the provided photos.

identity.kind: Thermal receipt printer and cash drawer

claims.evidence: No terminal, screen, or computer unit is shown in the photos.
Photos 0 and 2 show an Xprinter thermal printer.

risks.proof: A photo of the POS terminal unit (screen/computer) powered on.

risks.risk: The printer may have a damaged thermal head or failed motor.
risks.proof: A video of the printer producing a clear self-test printout.

proof_requests: Photo of the POS terminal unit mentioned in the description.
Video of the printer performing a self-test print.
Video of the cash drawer opening using both the key and the electronic trigger.
response.reason: The seller claims a complete POS terminal is included, but only the printer and cash drawer are pictured. The terminal is the most valuable component and its specifications are unknown.
